page.overview:
Who is Tekla Ansgar?

Tekla Ansgar was a female and a captain in the Republic Army during the Cold War. She was the leader of the team that investigated a crashed Sith starship on the planet Geonosis, alongside Lieutenant Norch and the Jedi Rojo Trace.
